title: Official pi package: ketch skill + extension tools installable via `pi install git:github.com/1broseidon/ketch`
summary: Audit (2026-10-19): the repo has an official Claude Code plugin (`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` → `plugins/ketch/`, which symlinks `skills/ketch` and registers `ketch mcp serve` via `.mcp.json`) but nothing for **pi** (badlogic/pi-mono, npm `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`). No board task, commit, or doc mentions it. pi does not speak MCP natively; its equivalent of our Claude Code plugin is a *pi package*: a `package.json` with a `pi` manifest exposing skills and extensions, installable with `pi install git:<repo>@<ref>` / `npm:<pkg>` / local path.
constraints: Never bundle or download the ketch binary; ketch on PATH is the prerequisite, same as the Claude Code plugin
No Go changes; existing CLI/MCP behavior untouched
@earendil-works/* and typebox only in peerDependencies ("*"), never dependencies
Tool param sets and descriptions mirror the MCP tools in mcp/; config-level settings are not tool params
A missing ketch binary must not break pi startup — it surfaces as a [precondition] tool error
